title: The Brothers' War Commander: card flavor text

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Artificer who repaired a music box for Kayla, came to pursue perfection, and poured his love, grief and hatred into the Sylex.

entities.name: Kayla
entities.description: Person who wondered whether Urza's repair of her music box showed affection or skill.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: Figure who ensured his most loyal followers were first to taste Phyrexian perfection.

entities.description: Teacher whose lessons on clarity of purpose Urza eventually understood.

entities.name: Sylex

entities.name: Ghalma the Shaper
entities.description: Speaker of a rallying proverb about death, will and necessity.

entities.name: Coruk

events.summary: Kayla wonders whether Urza's repair of her music box showed affection or skill.
events.quote: Kayla wondered if Urza's repair of the music box was a display of affection, or just of skill.

events.summary: Urza comes to understand Tocasia's lessons and makes perfection his goal.
events.quote: Perfection became his goal, and all other matters fell away in its pursuit.

events.summary: Urza pours his love, grief and hatred into the Sylex, shaking the Multiverse.
events.quote: Urza poured his love, his grief, and his hatred into the Sylex, and the Multiverse shook.

events.summary: Kiora steals the Bident of Thassa.
events.quote: Only Kiora would dare steal the weapon of a god.

events.summary: Tezzeret grafts the Planar Bridge into himself and his spark flares beyond his body.
events.quote: When I grafted the Planar Bridge into myself, I felt my Planeswalker spark flare beyond my body.

events.summary: Liliana urges the remaining consciousness of Oketra and Bontu to act against the usurper.
events.quote: Liliana whispered to whatever consciousness Oketra and Bontu had left.

events.summary: Jhoira takes the wheel of the Weatherlight for the first time in a millennium.
events.quote: Jhoira knew she'd been right to restore the ship.

events.summary: Ugin tells Jace the Eldrazi can be imprisoned.
events.quote: "You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin.

relations.note: Glissa recalls Slobad having been exiled
relations.quote: "I used to joke that he had been exiled for being too smart. Now I know why he never laughed."
But finding them will not be your challenge; living with the knowledge will be." —Samut, to Basri

rejected.summary: The war ends with no winner.
rejected.quote: In the end, the war had no winner.
